name: v2.5.25-dev.1-alpha1
body:
## What's new in v2.5.25-dev.1-alpha1

- chore: version 2.5.25 — the next cycle after the stable 2.5.24
- kiosk: favourites, presets and playlist editing from the screen; library search, genres, years, composers, new music, refresh
- Update YouTube iframe source in index.html
- site: screen requirement lists the resolutions offered in Settings
- site: UEFI came before 2015, say which PCs have it
- site: no OTA channels badge in the hero
- site: hero without the power and memory figures
- site: screenshots of the Qt interface
- site: absolute og:image, social meta tags and more room for the demo video
- site: hardware requirements before the download
- site: fewer warnings before the download button
- site: hero leads with the mini PC you already own and the Qt footprint
- site: the features the README lists and the page left out
- site: AGPL license, Qt interface and the current specs
- docs: A/B image, add-ons, VU meter store and the recent UI changes
- docs: the on-screen interface is Qt now, not Electron
